inputs.name: hand over from Orchestration to Model Serving Endpoint

output.level_0: The handover crashes, so the morning order window opens with stale or missing numbers.
output.level_1: No handover exists; the serving endpoint waits for a signal that never arrives from orchestration.
output.level_2: A technician manually copies the model artifact to the serving endpoint before the morning window.
output.level_3: Orchestration automatically pushes the trained model to the serving endpoint after each weekly retraining.
output.level_4: The automated handover verifies model signatures and logs the transfer for audit before serving begins.
